title: Drive List Ops — notes, ratings, skip, active banner, live timing, pitstops

tasks.title: drive_list_notes table + migration
tasks.detail: New table (drive_list_id FK, drive_list_stop_id FK nullable, body, source user|ai, read_at, created_at). Migration backfills drive_lists.notes JSON → rows (stop_id null). Additive only.
tasks.successCriteria: migrate:remote applied; existing drive notes appear as rows; drive_lists.notes untouched for back-compat read.

tasks.title: drive_list_stops: add kind, suggested, skipped, skipped_at
tasks.detail: kind enum core|optional|pitstop (backfill from is_optional), suggested bool default 0, skipped bool default 0, skipped_at ts. Keep is_optional.
tasks.successCriteria: columns exist on remote; kind backfilled; suggested/skipped default 0.

tasks.title: Install @reui/c-alert-5
tasks.detail: shadcn CLI --dry-run first; diff src/frontend/components/ui after; revert any shared primitive it rewrites.
tasks.successCriteria: Alert component in src/frontend/components/reui/; no unrelated primitive diff.

tasks.title: Notes CRUD API
tasks.detail: GET /:slug/notes (grouped), POST /:slug/notes {body,stopId?,source?}, PATCH /:slug/notes/:id {read}, DELETE /:slug/notes/:id.
tasks.successCriteria: QC: create drive + stop note, toggle read sets/clears read_at, delete removes.

tasks.title: Stop rating → showroom visit log
tasks.detail: POST /:slug/stops/:stopId/rating {rating, contextMarkdown?, deferFeedback?}. Resolves stop.showroomStoreId → records showroom visit + rating. 400 if no linked showroom. deferFeedback creates an ai note via B4.
tasks.successCriteria: QC: rating a linked stop creates a visit row with that rating; unlinked stop → 400; defer creates the ai note.

tasks.title: Skip toggle on stop PATCH
tasks.detail: Extend PATCH /:slug/stops/:stopId to accept {skipped}. Sets skipped_at. Excluded from progress.
tasks.successCriteria: QC: skip/unskip flips the flag; progress ignores skipped stops.

tasks.title: Notes as collapsible alerts
tasks.detail: Render drive + per-stop notes as reui Alerts; collapsed when read_at set, expandable; +Note inline composer (plain text).
tasks.successCriteria: notes show as alerts, mark-read collapses + persists, reload keeps state.

tasks.title: Star rating card row + fullscreen modal
tasks.detail: Stars on the card (linked stops only); tap → fullscreen Dialog with big stars preselected + optional feedback textarea + 'AI follow up later' button.
tasks.successCriteria: rate from modal writes visit; AI-later creates the dated ai note; card reflects new rating.

tasks.title: Skip button + confirm + crossed-out minimized + unskip
tasks.detail: Skip → confirm Dialog → minimized struck card with Unskip only.
tasks.successCriteria: skip confirms + minimizes + strikes; unskip restores.

tasks.title: drive_lists: started_at, start_latitude, start_longitude
tasks.detail: Additive columns for start capture on activation.
tasks.successCriteria: columns on remote.

tasks.title: GET /api/drive-lists/active
tasks.detail: Lightweight {slug,title}|null for the global banner.
tasks.successCriteria: returns active drive or null; used by banner.

tasks.title: Activation captures start_at + location (on top of #242)
tasks.detail: Extend PATCH /:slug {isActive:true} (already edited by #242) to set started_at + start coords from Tesla GPS → phone fix, fire-and-forget. Respect 07:00-20:00 gate.
tasks.successCriteria: activating inside window sets started_at + coords; deactivate keeps started_at.

tasks.title: Feasibility plan endpoint
tasks.detail: GET /:slug/plan — structured-hours resolver (linked showroom) + drive-route-planner from started_at/start coords; per-stop {etaLocal,dwellMin,waitMin,feasible,reason}. Cache per (drive, started_at, stopset).
tasks.successCriteria: QC: returns timing for linked+hours stops; correct won't-make-it flag on a late start; unlinked stops omit timing.

tasks.title: Install @reui/c-button-53 (sliding button)
tasks.detail: shadcn CLI --dry-run first; revert shared-primitive rewrites.
tasks.successCriteria: sliding button available; no unrelated primitive diff.

tasks.title: Activate button on drive viewport header
tasks.detail: Activate/Active toggle in the drive header; shows 409 window reason inline.
tasks.successCriteria: activates the drive; reflects active state.

tasks.title: Global active-drive banner in BaseLayout
tasks.detail: client:only island polling /active; Return (sliding button) + End (confirm → PATCH isActive:false). Sticky, high contrast.
tasks.successCriteria: banner shows on every page when a drive is active; return navigates; end confirms + clears.

tasks.title: Per-stop timing display
tasks.detail: Render plan chip per stop: 'stay ~N min · ETA', or 'won't make it — closes HH:MM'. No chip when no timing.
tasks.successCriteria: timing chips match /plan; late stops flagged; unlinked show none.

tasks.title: Proximity pitstop generator (D1-only, no Google cost)
tasks.detail: In createDriveList (MCP + API): after core stops, haversine registered showrooms within 5-10mi of route, open in drive window, not already on drive → insert kind='pitstop', suggested=1, is_optional=1.
tasks.successCriteria: new drive gets suggested pitstops (or 0); no Google call at create; suggested excluded from progress/timing/map.

tasks.title: Promote pitstop
tasks.detail: PATCH /:slug/stops/:stopId {suggested:false}; promoted stop enters /plan recalc.
tasks.successCriteria: QC: promote flips suggested; promoted pitstop appears in /plan.

tasks.title: Fullscreen showroom detail modal
tasks.detail: Tap card (outside buttons) → Dialog with condensed showroom card from /api/showroom-stores/:id (name, phone, photos, brands, products, actions). Linked stops only; lazy fetch.
tasks.successCriteria: modal shows real showroom data; unlinked stops don't open it; loading/error states.

tasks.title: Pitstop card rendering + Add-to-drive
tasks.detail: Suggested pitstops minimized by default under nearest core stop, dashed, 'Proximity pitstop' badge; expand → full affordances; Add to drive → promote (D2).
tasks.successCriteria: pitstops minimized by default; full card on expand; Add promotes + joins timing.
